clips.send: Can a country get richer and cleaner and fairer at the same time — or does it have to choose? In about forty years China went from a poor country to the world’s second-largest economy, and paid a price in smoggy air and polluted rivers along the way. Today Chinese ninth-graders study three key words for what comes next: innovation (创新, chuàngxīn), sharing (共享, gòngxiǎng) and green (绿色, lǜsè).
